requirement_summary: 02_FUNCTIONAL_REQUIREMENTS_AND_PROGRAMS.md FR-COM-007: '모든 자동 Patch는 별도 Worktree와 Branch에서 수행한다.'
subject: SemanticAssuranceV2WorkflowService.patchIsolationCheck via assurance.patch.isolation-check; contracts/patch-isolation-check.v1.schema.json (NEW)
coverage_notes: worktree_isolated and branch_isolated are two independent real checks, each individually tested: patchIsolationCheckDetectsThePatchRunningInTheMainWorktree proves a patch whose declared worktree path equals the main workspace's own path is caught even when its branch name is legitimately non-protected. patchIsolationCheckDetectsThePatchOnAProtectedBranchEvenInADifferentWorktree proves the converse -- a genuinely separate worktree does not excuse running directly on a protected branch name, closing both halves of '별도 Worktree와 Branch' (separate worktree AND branch, not either/or). The valid case (patchIsolationCheckIsIsolatedInADifferentWorktreeAndBranch) uses this session's own actual real worktree paths (/workspace/ONSure-development vs /workspace/ONSure) as the fixture data, reflecting the genuine isolation this session's own patches have operated under throughout.
open_gap: Operates on a caller-supplied worktree-path and branch-name representation; there is no live git/CI orchestration layer in this codebase that actually intercepts an automated patch operation at the moment it runs and feeds this gate from real process state (same disclosed 'caller-supplied representation, not live system integration' pattern as every other real-computation closure this session) -- this operation can verify a claimed worktree/branch pairing is isolated, but does not itself enforce isolation by preventing a patch process from running in the main worktree in the first place.
